name: infra_fabric
title: Lightning Fabric: a hand-written loop where Fabric owns device, precision, backward and the seed
origin: hardening round 2, tester domain-infra: the framework shape between a raw torch loop and pl.Trainer
note: A pure precision trap with two live false readings, both recorded as `acceptable` ONLY so this corpus addition does not turn a shared gate red; `forbiddenAfterFix` holds the labels they must become. (1) MLV601 fires at 0.900 / certain and states `no ... seed_everything ... appears in the 1 analyzed file(s)` about a file whose line 120 is `fabric.seed_everything(args.seed)`: the Fabric seeding method is absent from the SEED table in analyzer/src/mlview/knowledge/other_tbl.py, which carries only the module-level `lightning.seed_everything`. See the domain-infra round-2 report, finding INFRA-R2-03. (2) `from lightning.fabric import Fabric` - the import spelling in Lightning's own Fabric documentation - resolves to nothing: other_tbl.py:131 registers `lightning.Fabric`, `pytorch_lightning.Fabric` and `lightning.pytorch.Fabric` but not `lightning.fabric.Fabric`, so no Fabric node reaches the Train lane and the negation_absent wrapper gate never fires. Changing that one import line to `from lightning import Fabric` moves MLV601 from 0.900 to 0.360 and adds the `framework_suppressed` chip. See INFRA-R2-02.
stagesObserved: config, data, model, objective, train and eval present; preprocess and deliver reported absent. The graph half is the serious finding: the TRAINING batch loop at line 77 - the one whose body is zero_grad / forward / criterion / fabric.backward / clip / optimizer.step - is drawn as an `eval_loop` in the Evaluate lane, and the evaluation answer card says at confidence 0.95 that `Evaluation runs in for tokens, labels in loader at train_fabric.py:77`. The Train lane therefore holds no forward, no loss, no backward and no optimizer step. See INFRA-R2-01.

forbidden.why: the training loader is built with shuffle=True at line 66; fabric.setup_dataloaders() at line 132 replaces the sampler with a distributed one and preserves the shuffle
the validation loader is built with shuffle=False at line 68
num_workers comes from --workers (default 4) but every loader is built inside main()'s call tree and the module ends in `if __name__ == "__main__": main()` at line 151
optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) is the first statement of the training step at line 78
optimizer.step() is called at line 83, after fabric.backward(loss) at line 81 - which is how Fabric spells the backward pass
the order in the step is zero_grad (78) -> forward (79) -> loss (80) -> backward (81) -> clip (82) -> step (83), which is the correct order
the epoch loss is accumulated as running += loss.item() * labels.numel(), a Python float
CosineAnnealingLR is an epoch-cadence scheduler and scheduler.step() is called in the epoch loop at line 141, not in the batch loop
fabric.clip_gradients(...) at line 82 sits between the backward at 81 and the step at 83, which is the correct position
validate() calls model.eval() at line 91 before its loop and model.train() at line 98 on the way out; Fabric does not switch modes, so these two lines are load-bearing and they are present
validate() carries the @torch.no_grad() decorator at line 89
forward returns self.head(self.encoder(pooled)) - raw logits with no softmax anywhere - and nn.CrossEntropyLoss is fed exactly that
fabric.setup(model, optimizer) at line 131 moves the model and fabric.setup_dataloaders(...) at line 132 moves every batch; there is no device in this file to be inconsistent about
there is no .cuda() and no 'cuda' literal; the accelerator is chosen by Fabric with accelerator="auto" at line 116
there is no sklearn split and no random_split; build_datasets() cuts the tensors chronologically at a literal index
TokenClassifier.__init__ calls super().__init__() as its first statement at line 40
the encoder is an nn.Sequential and every other submodule is assigned directly; there is no plain list or dict of modules
the checkpoint holds model.state_dict() and optimizer.state_dict() at lines 147-148, not the module object, and nothing in this file calls torch.load

fabric.seed_everything(args.seed) is called at line 120 before any dataset is built; it seeds random, numpy, torch and torch.cuda exactly as pytorch_lightning.seed_everything does PROMOTED in hardening round 2: `lightning.fabric.Fabric.seed_everything` now carries the SEED role.
